## Where you are

You are in the user's project, with the tools the session grants you. The swarm's documents are in the
`sciame/` folder, at the project root: `PIPELINE.md` (the strategies and the phases), `PREAMBOLO.md` (the extended
rules), `AGENTI.md` (the cards of all the roles), `GIURIA.md` (jury, new experts, plenary). If there is
`sciame/locale/`, its cards and rules apply in place of the generic ones. Write only in the folder that
the brief gives you; the rest of the project you only read. If a tool is missing or denied to you, do not work around it:
say so in the deliverable, and mark as «not verified» whatever you could not test.

You have no tools: no files, no shell, no network. You work on the text of the brief, and your answer is the
deliverable. What would need testing you state together with the test it would take, and mark it «not verified».

# The agent swarm: the role cards

The roles are **professionals**, the general skills, and **sub-professionals**, their specialisations: a
sub-professional comes right after its professional, numbered «7.2». This file is generated from the single
database `sciame/db/professionisti.json`, in the chosen language: it is not edited by hand. A new role is added with
`bash sciame/sciame.sh approva <scheda>`; a project's own cards live in `sciame/locale/AGENTI.md` and
always take priority over the generic roles with the same code name.

Outside the swarm is the **coordinator**: the main session that receives the request. Decisions are made by
the user, unless a jury has a written delegation.
descrizione_coda: Swarm agent (core {nucleo}); convened by the coordinator.
prompt_ruolo:
You are the role «{nome}» (card {n}) of the agent swarm: {breve}

A coordinator convenes you with a brief: carry it out in your role and deliver as the brief says. You do not see the
coordinator's conversation or the work of the other roles, except what the brief gives you. Answer in English,
unless the brief asks for another language.
nota_agente: generated from the card «{n}. {nome}» of the swarm database: do not edit by hand, regenerate with bash sciame/sciame.sh rigenera
nota_skill: generated from the swarm documents: do not edit by hand, regenerate with bash sciame/sciame.sh rigenera
nota_documento: generated by the swarm in the chosen language: edit it at its source, sciame/documenti/ or sciame/db/
indice_spiega:
A role is convened by the name in the first column. The keywords help the choice: add to the profile's roles
those whose keywords appear in the request. A sub-professional is convened in place of its
professional when the request falls within its specialisation.

skill_descrizione.auto: Convenes the agent swarm, leaving the coordinator to choose the strategy (singolo, ventaglio, classica, giuria, completa, plenaria, esperto) and the roles. Use it only when the user asks for the swarm without saying which convening.
skill_descrizione.singolo: Single swarm expert: one specialist, the best suited or the one named, with a complete brief (1 agent). For a clear question in one field or a small task. Use it only when the user asks for the swarm or one of its experts.
skill_descrizione.ventaglio: Swarm fan-out: N agents in parallel, on slices of a job or racing on the same brief under a selection rule declared in advance; a table of outcomes (2 to 16 agents). Use it only when the user asks for the fan-out or for parallel work with the swarm.
skill_descrizione.classica: Classic swarm convening: contract, two blind lanes, triage, falsifiers' tournament, one team per hypothesis, tests and verdicts (6 to 15 agents). For deciding, designing, fixing, proving or measuring. Use it only when the user asks for the classic convening.
skill_descrizione.giuria: Swarm jury: a proposal already prepared, a jury that votes (consensus approves, majority revises for up to three rounds, minority rejects); as a rule the outcome is a recommendation to the user (7 to 11 agents). Use it only when the user asks for the jury.
skill_descrizione.completa: Full swarm convening: all the professionals in one blind round without a vote, the arbiter's consolidation, then the classic (costly). For strategic or open questions that touch many fields. Use it only when the user asks for the full convening.
skill_descrizione.plenaria: Swarm plenary: full convening, usual convening, critical pass, two arbiters, final vote with consensus (60 to 80 agents and more). Only for phase transitions and choices of enormously important impact, at the user's explicit request.
skill_descrizione.esperto: New swarm expert: convenes a skill that no role has, with a provisional card, and records the request; at the threshold it proposes creating the role. Use it only when the user asks for an expert the swarm does not have.
skill_descrizione.giuria-leggera: Light jury of the swarm: for small, low-influence decisions, or where a mistake shows up with a quick test: three jurors (the competent role, a critic, the goal guardian), the test before the vote, a single round, then the ordinary jury if needed (5 agents). Use it only when the user asks for the light jury.

skill_titolo.auto: Swarm: the coordinator chooses the strategy

auto_premessa: **You choose the strategy of this convening**, with the rules below; then follow the paragraph of the chosen strategy.
completa_premessa: **The strategy of this convening is the full one**, which after the consolidation continues like the classic.
plenaria_premessa: **The strategy of this convening is the plenary.** Before launching agents, check that the user has confirmed it and state the cost. The complete rules are in `sciame/GIURIA.md`, §5.

## The request

$ARGUMENTS

(If there is no text above, the request is the user's last message. If it starts with `lingua=<code>`, answer in that language.)
cli_non_installato: the swarm is not in {radice} yet. First: bash sciame.sh installa
cli_lingua_cambiata: Swarm language: {lingua}. Agents, skills and documents regenerated.
cli_lingua_sconosciuta: language «{lingua}» not available. Available: {lingue}. A new language is proposed with a pull request (CONTRIBUTING.md).
cli_allineato: {ruoli} roles and {profili} profiles: catalogue, agents, skills and documents in line with the sources
cli_non_allineato: Not in line with the sources: bash sciame/sciame.sh rigenera
cli_saltati: Not touched, because not generated by the swarm (overrides or project files): {n}
cli_manca_richiesta: the request is missing: bash sciame/sciame.sh {strategia} "request"
cli_manca_claude: the claude command is missing: install Claude Code and log in
cli_approvato: Role sciame-{sigla} added to the database ({tipo}). Agents, skills and documents regenerated; sciame.sh rebuilt: {sciame_sh}. Proposal for the public repository: {proposta}
cli_proposta_scritta: Proposal written in {percorso}. To send it as a pull request: {comando}
cli_aggiornato: Updated {n} factory files; protected because modified in the project: {protetti}
